verdict.rationale: Ramp's own product page directly claims auto top-up from linked checking accounts, target-balance automation and low-balance alerts, which covers both parts of the story. Supporting material shows automated bank transfers and a Banking API for reading balances. The evidence is only a one-line marketing claim, though. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring top-up rules, thresholds and alert channels; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts
